description: This Java class 'ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' is a final, immutable builder used for creating responses and events related to modify features commands in a live system within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to generate command responses and event instances such as feature creation and modification, and handles specific error scenarios.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing a builder for creating command responses and events related to modifying features in a live system, using a fluent API.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable inner class providing implementations to create various command responses and error responses.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable inner class providing implementations to create feature created and modified event instances.
